name: Explosive Pistol
author: wolfsdk
description: The standard pistol fires the rocket of the Kampfpistole (launcher attachment), which explodes on impact; the magazine holds 30 instead of 10 rounds, also with the magazine upgrade. The ammo and the three projectile upgrades (silencer, elephant rounds, both together) point straight to projectile/player/kampf_pistol_rocket. The pistol therefore takes over the launcher's firing sound, recoil and direct-hit damage, and the silencer no longer makes it quiet. The rocket only arms after about 5 m of flight; if it hits closer, it bounces off and goes off after 3 s. Version 1.0.0 let the pistol projectile inherit from the rocket; that did not arrive in the game because the engine loads the pistol before the rocket (re_probes/agent_reports/explosivpistole_diag.md). The 30-round magazine is confirmed in game. The explosion is only checked structurally (tools/verify_weapon_mod.py) and not yet confirmed in game. Retail decls only, every entry fits its slot, no archive rebuild. The upgrade files are retail versions: magazine_size from patch_3 without indentation, elephantrounds from patch_2 unchanged, because the loader writes one file into every copy.
